3.2 The author further contends that the foreman of the jury was an
acquaintance of the deceased, and that the court was therefore not impartial.
It is further submitted that the defence was not informed at the preliminary
hearing that the prosecution would call a third witness at the trial, so that
no counter-arguments could be prepared.
